metadata.case_name: LIN CHO CHAU v. YCY DESIGN & ENGINEERING LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: construction site casual worker; domestic assistant

injuries.description: incomplete crack fracture of the left radius
source: The diagnosis of the plaintiff by PWH was that he had incomplete crack fracture of the left radius,

injuries.description: 100% cut of 5 muscles including one that extended from the lower end of the humerus to the lower end of the radius which is a flexor of the elbow joint
source: The diagnosis of the plaintiff by PWH was that he had ... 100% cut of 5 muscles including one that extended from the lower end of the humerus to the lower end of the radius which is a flexor of the elbow joint,
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level

source: The diagnosis of the plaintiff by PWH was that he had ... 100% cut of a radial nerve
injuries.icd_description: Injury of radial nerve at forearm level

source: The diagnosis of the plaintiff by PWH was that he had ... and 95% cut of the median nerve.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of median nerve at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: 5 cm deep cut wound on the left forearm with visible cuts of 3 tendons
source: He was diagnosed to have a 5 cm deep cut wound on the left forearm. There were visible cuts of 3 tendons.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level

injuries.description: scarring: 10.5 cm transverse scar at volar surface over distal 1/3 of forearm and a 4 cm longitudinal scar joining the radial edge of the transverse scar; radial part of transverse scar tied and attached to underlying structures
source: He has a 10.5 cm transverse scar at volar surface over distal 1/3 of forearm and a 4 cm longitudinal scar joining the radial edge of the transverse scar. The radial part of the transverse scar was tied and attached to the underlying structures.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at forearm level

manifestations.description: persistent numbness over the index and middle fingers
diminished protective sensation of the thumb, index and middle fingers and the palm
tendons healed but weak; limited grip and pinch strengths

difficulty performing daily tasks like grasping tight jar lid during opening, holding rice bowl tightly and stably, pinching out keys and coins out of pocket of his pants and pulling up pants after toileting
severe muscle wasting over the left upper limb
loss of protective sensation of the three fingers of the palm (shown on sensation chart)
unable to cope with the job demand of an interior decorator

treatments_received: second operation to release the tendons and the radial and median nerves (23 April 2005)
physiotherapy (wrist and finger mobilization, scar management and grip strengthening exercise; electrical stimulation)

losses.description: Reduced left wrist mobility and grip strength; diminished protective sensation of the thumb, index and middle fingers; weakness and muscle wasting of the left upper limb.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty performing daily tasks like grasping tight jar lid during opening, holding rice bowl tightly and stably, pinching out keys and coins out of pocket of his pants and pulling up pants after toileting.
Unable to cope with the job demand of an interior decorator.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Kai Wing v Leung Fat Kee Engineering Co. Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: Serious injury to dominant right hand: deep front and back transverse cut of the right hand, decreased movement of the ring and little fingers, fractures of the 3rd and 4th metacarpal bones; dislocation of the 5th metacarpal-phalangeal joint; crushed 2nd, 3rd and 4th web interossie; crushed digital nerves to the middle ring and little fingers and total loss of hypothenar muscle.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ho Kai Hong v Cheung Kok
comparable_cases.injury_description: 5 cm oblique chop wound at the left distal forearm and a cortical break at the distal left radius; multiple cuts of the extensor tendons on the forearm and a cut of the superficial branch of the radial nerve.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Major loss of the muscle bulk of his right dominant forearm; stiff wrist; partial loss of sensation of the fingers; limited movement of thumb and fingers; ugly scars.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Right dominant hand crushed with open fracture of proximal phalangeal joint of the index finger, closed fracture of proximal phalangeal of middle finger and traumatic amputation of the right thumb; free vascularised big toe transfer; significant impairment and psychiatric consequences.
